description: This Java class defines a specialized assertion helper for testing JsonValue objects, providing methods to verify JSON string equality and simple string equality within a testing framework.

classes.name: JsonValueAssert
classes.description: A final class extending an abstract JSON value assertion, providing custom assertion methods for JsonValue objects.

methods.name: JsonValueAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion with the actual JsonValue object to be tested.

methods.name: hasJsonString
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonValue's string representation matches the expected JSON string using strict JSON comparison.

methods.name: hasSimpleString
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonValue's string representation equals the expected simple string.
